description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Timeless Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Timeless Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Timeless Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
